summary.content:
Today's selection covers 55 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 33 on Artificial Intelligence and 8 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Can an Apple lawsuit derail OpenAI’s hardware plans?
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: US charges two over laundering $43 million from investment fraud
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, The Verge, NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 9 articles published in the last 24 hours
